entities.name: Cyprien Biyehima Kihangire
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cipriano Biyehima Kihangire, was a Ugandan Roman Catholic priest who served as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Gulu, from 19 December 1968 until 9 January 1988.
